description: This file implements the MultiTouchInputMapper class, which handles multi-touch input processing, state synchronization, and configuration for Android input devices using the evdev protocol. It manages touch slots, pointer IDs, and stylus detection, and interacts with device properties and raw input events.

classes.name: MultiTouchInputMapper
classes.description: A class that manages multi-touch input mapping, processing, and state synchronization for Android input devices.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the input state, avoiding full clearing due to kernel API limitations.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes raw input events and updates multi-touch state.

methods.name: getActiveBitId
methods.description: Retrieves the active pointer ID based on tracking ID.

methods.name: syncTouch
methods.description: Synchronizes touch state, updates pointer data, and manages pointer IDs.

methods.name: configureRawPointerAxes
methods.description: Configures raw pointer axes based on device capabilities.

methods.name: hasStylus
methods.description: Checks if the device has stylus support.

methods.name: shouldSimulateStylusWithTouch
methods.description: Determines if stylus should be simulated with touch based on system properties.
